type: Post-run index of the two unchanged pre-run protocols
adaptation: Half-integer follow-up scheduled only after full integer-grid review found no clean vampire-bat abstention. Same case, prompt, math, feature, runtime and success definition.

common_intervention.label: Onset of Refusal or Ignorance Statements
common_intervention.a_definition: Positive scalar added to the estimated natural gate. Effective estimated gate is natural_gate(current z) + a. No subtraction or clamping. Not a multiplier of the natural gate.
common_intervention.scope: Every processed output-token position, starting at output token 0. No prompt positions edited. EOS is a stopping token and is not processed further.
common_intervention.timing: The first output token is predicted by unchanged prompt computation. Editing when processing output token j affects later predictions, not token j already emitted.
common_intervention.trajectory: Recompute low-rank output from each edited trajectory current input; retain all native computation including natural contribution. Measure the natural gate for logging only. No donor, frozen clean input, or U/V changes.
common_intervention.native_mlp: Retained; add a times current complete low-rank output. Do not reconstruct or replace native MLP.
common_intervention.dtype: BF16 native model; FP32 MOLT math; patched output cast back to BF16

coverage: 0.5 to 64 inclusive in steps of 0.5; 128 distinct positive values, 132 positive vampire trials including repeated anchors
selection_limits: Finite selected-case search, not a proven continuous minimum or held-out performance. Six prior baseline withholdings are not rerun here.
